message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The defendant is a health administrative law enforcement officer (卫生监督科主任) who, when dealing with illegal medical practice cases, instead of referring to criminal prosecution, gave administrative penalties repeatedly, thereby allowing continued illegal practice. This is abuse of power, dereliction of duty, possibly "滥用职权" (abuse of power) or "徇私舞弊" (accepting bribes? Not mentioned). The description: "徇私舞弊，对依法应当移交司法机关追究刑事责任的...不移交，放纵其继续实施非法行医犯罪活动". This is likely "徇私舞弊" which is a crime under Chinese criminal law: "徇私舞弊罪" (abuse of power for personal gain). Also "滥用职权罪" (abuse of authority). The examples: earlier similar case: "受贿;滥用职权". Here no bribery, but abuse of authority to avoid criminal prosecution for personal economic benefit. So crime: "徇私舞弊罪" (also known as "滥用职权罪"? Actually Chinese law: Article 397 of Criminal Law: "徇私舞弊罪" (abuse of power for personal gain). Also "滥用职权罪" is Article 397? Wait: Article 397: "国家机关工作人员徇私舞弊，致使国家和人民利益受到重大损失的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处罚金；情节严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金。" So the crime is "徇私舞弊". Also "滥用职权" is similar but maybe separate. In examples, they used "受贿;滥用职权". Here we have no bribery, just "徇私舞弊". So answer: [罪名]徇私舞弊<eoa>
